title: Vibecoded a point&click game
author: DearObjective4053
selftext:
Made a thing with opus 5.5, a mix between one of my fav games ( monkey island ) and my fav movie (grand Budapest hotel. It’s just a quick demo with 4 levels.

The demo takes around 30 minutes to finish.

Tools: opus 5.5 - image 2.5 - seedance - elevenlabs

https://hotel-pomeranz.pages.dev

Curious to hear thoughts! And ama about my process

comments.author: OWazabi
comments.body: Looks cool I like the art, how did you made that hero background?

replies.author: OWazabi
replies.body: oh surprising results, I thought it was something with cut off layers and all, the animation and effect on hover are super clean

replies.author: DearObjective4053
replies.body: Image 2.5 with code on top and seedance renders mixed in basically!

replies.author: OWazabi
replies.body: I see, well done, lovely results

comments.author: sanctumreborn
comments.body: This is really cool - will definitely return and check it out in more detail when I have time .

replies.author: DearObjective4053
replies.body:
Appreciate it! My first post on Reddit so not sure I placed it right. I’ve been building stuff for a while so looking forward to share more.

Demo is around 30 min and fun to play imo!

comments.author: Aggravating-Vehicle9
comments.body: Are the voices AI? I think this sort of thing could come alive with good voice acting.

replies.author: DearObjective4053
replies.body: Yeah it’s elevenlabs via their api!

replies.author: Aggravating-Vehicle9
replies.body: Right, I think the AI voices are really great for prototyping voices, but I do find them awful to listen to as entertainment.

replies.author: DearObjective4053
replies.body: In an ideal world this would be real voices but for now I guess we’ll have to wait for elevenlabs v5 😁

comments.author: acrolicious
comments.body:
This is cool! I think something like this would work really well for my one and two button platform. Thanks for the inspiration. 
And if you haven't considered making it one and two switch playable, maybe you could? I could even adapt it if you have any interest. It would allow more people to play with just one or two buttons who might be disabled. 
(Just an example of what I'm talking about: https://narbehouse.github.io/bennyshub/apps/games/BENNYSFISHMYSTERY/index.html )
